simple.summary: חַנָּתֹן (Channâthôn) means Channathon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 14.

definitions.full: H2615. Channathon חַנָּתֹן proper name, of a location place in the tribe of Zebulun Josh 19:14 ; ᵐ5 Αμωθ , Αενναθωθ , ᵐ5 L Αναθωθ ; site unknown; according to Conder = Talm, Caphar Hanania (Nbr Geogr. 176. 226 ) on the border of Upper and Lower Galilee, modern Kefr' Anân, Survey WP i. 205, 207 .
